label: has organizational or political leader
definition: Organization or political body X has person Y as a leader or holder of a leadership office.
scope_notes: Possessive leader/president and inverse leader appositions dominate. This is the inverse direction of the prior leadership predicate, explicitly X body to Y person. Ordinary membership, geographic co-occurrence and interaction alone do not qualify.

facts.reason: Israel explicitly has Shimon Peres as minister, president and leader; possible-under and triumvirate paths are additional.
Ralph J. Marino is explicitly identified as Senate leader through noun, of and possessive appositions; spokesman and aide paths attach to that leader.
Syria explicitly has Hafez al-Assad as president, leader and dictator; meeting and rejection paths are additional interactions.
China explicitly has Jiang Zemin as president and leader and includes him among its leaders.
Bob Dole is explicitly Senate leader through several apposition paths; vacating a seat and proposal/supporter paths are additional.
